rules.statement: A Fiscal's conveyance, once executed, relates back to the date of the sale and vests title in the purchaser, even if the conveyance is issued after the institution of legal proceedings.
rules.supporting_quote: "It was there argued that on the execution of the Fiscal's transfer the purchaser's title related back to the date of the purchase. For some purposes that may be so, but I doubt whether it would affect the rights of third parties who may have intervened in consequence of the purchaser's delay in perfecting his title and in any case it cannot affect the question' in this case, which is, whether Weerakoon had a good title at the date of the seizure."

meta.parties: Edwin and Another v. Sugathadasa De Silva
